verdict.rationale: Ardent documents a REST API (/v1 endpoints), so a downloadable spec is a fair question. However, no OpenAPI or equivalent spec is documented, and a probe of the common candidate paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 for all of them. The llms.txt file is a docs index rather than a machine-readable API spec, and Markdown API reference pages do not qualify either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
